text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has emerged victorious<n>in the battle
between queens today!<n>Congratulations once again
to Mejiro<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I was so absorbed in the race that<n>I'm not even
sure of how I ran...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But I won! I beat Air Groove... I've<n>finally reached
my ide—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What a disappointing loss. However,<n>I cannot
waste time wallowing in<n>regret.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must never forget this feeling... but I<n>must move
forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't let things end here. I shall not<n>rest until I've
reclaimed my honor as<n>Empress!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...My legs are starting to shake.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Just being exposed to Air Groove's<n>overwhelming
spirit is making me<n>tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How can I say I've reached my ideal<n>self when I
can't even remember<n>how I ran during the race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if I ran again, I can't guarantee<n>I'd be able to
seize the lead without<n>any risk of being overtaken...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is no good...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to accomplishanything at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I must become like Air Groove! I<n>can't build a new
legacy if I don't!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I have to do something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race in the Takarazuka<n>Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober makes her declaration<n>the moment
she returns to the waiting<n>room, her expression
filled with<n>desperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I realized something chasing after Air<n>Groove. The
distance between the<n>two of us is still too great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But this isn't the time to be getting<n>depressed. I'm
not the same person I<n>was after the Arima Kinen.
I'm going<n>to keep fighting this battle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No doubt Air Groove will be running in<n>the spring
Grand Prix—the Takarazuka<n>Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And if that's the case, then I'm<n>running in it too! I
have to face off<n>against her again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to figure out what's preventing<n>me from
becoming like her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's that feeling again...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That same strange sense of unease<n>I've
experienced before rattles loudly<n>in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My lips part, and before I know it, a<n>question spills
forth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no point asking her such a<n>thing when I
myself can't put what<n>I'm feeling into words yet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I need to think this through and find<n>an answer...
Only then can I talk to<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You're so weird.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In any case, our next goal is<n>decided—she'll be
running in the<n>Takarazuka Kinen.
